'''How a label gets onto Wikidata today — the whole pipeline:'''
# '''Sources of English labels''' (all end up as atomic QS files in <code>modern-quickstatements/</code>): the shinto-wiki page names (<code>fetch_en_labels_from_wiki.py</code> — [[QuickStatements/en labels]] wiki page is the hand-curated source); kana-derived romanizations (<code>kana_en_labels</code>, <code>identical_name_en_labels</code>, temple variants); the daily claude.ai Sonnet routine translating batches of shrines/temples picked by <code>select_shrines_to_translate.py</code> (<code>en_labels_sonnet</code>); and RAG-corrected typo fixes (<code>label_typo_fixes</code>, from the 161-item review queue).
# '''The 70-language machinery''' (<code>shinto-label-generator/</code>, <code>language_registry.py</code> is the single source of truth for which language uses which method): transliteration from the English/romaji form for most languages; Chinese via kana→man'yōgana + OpenCC for the zh family; Korean via koreanize (Japan) / hanja; Indonesian "Kuil X" proposals; Toki Pona; plus specialized generators for kami, Buddhist deities, misc Shinto terms, concepts (hand-authored), properties (hand-authored), court ranks, provinces, texts. Every output line carries a provenance comment. ~2.6M proposed labels currently sit in <code>quickstatements/&lt;lang&gt;.txt</code>.
# '''The drip:''' <code>select_label_proposals.py</code> feeds 20 proposals per CI run into <code>label_proposals_drip.txt</code>; everything flows to Wikidata through the single daily editor (<code>direct_daily_edits.py</code>, 300/day, random interleave).
# '''The uniqueness interlock (new this week):''' a label can only land if the label+description pair is unique — stale descriptions block label adds, so the description program runs alongside: desc-then-label pairs (100/day), class-true description adds (50/day until 2027-01), and collision groups routed to cloud enrichment for unique English descriptions (236 work-files live).
# '''Guards:''' label-generator outputs never overwrite existing labels (non-destructive checks); label-typo review corrects the legacy romaji typos; the edits-today tile on the dashboard counts the account's total daily Wikidata edits.

'''Why <code>shrine-ranking.html</code> looked frozen''' ''(answers the 2026-07-09 anomaly-corrections item; picked up into <code>queue.md</code>)''
* The page ''is'' rebuilt every day — today's build stamps <code>Last updated: 2026-07-09 06:39 UTC</code>. Nothing is cached and nothing was disabled.
* The counts barely moved (P361 387→386 in three weeks; P1448 105 and P6375 252 never moved) because '''nothing drains them''' — there is no bot fixing these duplicates, so the number only changes when you fix one by hand.
* What made it look stale: the ''"Example of all three issues on a single item: Q59282644 (Takagi Shrine)"'' line is '''hardcoded''' in the generator, so it survived you fixing Takagi. Q59282644 now has 1×P361, 1×P1448, 1×P6375.
* The page now has real tables: one column per competing address / official name / part-of statement, English labels instead of QIDs, and citations as numbered Wikipedia-style footnotes. Excepted so far: Izawa-no-Miya, Izumo-daijingū, Izawa Shrine, Samugawa Shrine, Baba Tsutsukowake Shrine, plus every item whose two addresses are one Japanese and one romanised (the same address written twice). P6375 is down to '''198'''.
